chunks: Al-Saffar from Muhammad ibn Isa from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman from al-Daqqaq said:

I asked him about a man who has a female slave, and that female slave has a female slave, and her master gifted her to her. Is it permissible for him to have intercourse with her? He said, and he said, 'There is no harm.'

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: There is no harm / It is permissible
key_terms.يَطَأَهَا: To have intercourse with her / to consummate

ai.seo_question: Can a master have intercourse with a female slave he gifted to another female slave?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the specific juristic ruling regarding 'double slavery,' where a master gifts his female slave to another female slave who is also owned by him. Shaykh al-Tusi records the Imam’s response of 'la ba’s' (no harm), indicating that the original owner retains the right of consummation (*ibahah*) with the gifted slave, as the gift transfers her status but not necessarily the exclusive right of sexual access in this hierarchical context. This highlights the flexibility of ownership rights in early Shia jurisprudence regarding concubinage and the fluidity of marital bonds within the master-slave dynamic.
